changes.title: Automatic Continue Watching
changes.description: Start watching on Netflix, HBO Max, Disney+, Prime Video, or Apple TV in Wianu. Your videos appear automatically in Continue Watching in the sidebar, so you can return to them later.

changes.title: What's New
changes.description: See the latest changes after updating Wianu. Reopen these notes anytime from the Help menu.

changes.title: Support Wianu
changes.description: Enjoying Wianu? A new optional reminder lets you support its development. You can dismiss it or turn off future reminders.
